messages:
alex: starting a staged rollout of inference-api v3.1.2 to eu-west-1 canary now (2026-03-15T22:05Z). small batch, watching metrics. ping me if you see anything odd.

deployment-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for inference-api v3.1.2 on cluster eu-west-1 (rollout id r-2240013377).

mike: seeing error rate jump on /generate from ~0.7% -> 3.2% in the last 2m for eu-west canary. lots of 502/504.
alex: ack. can you paste a sample of the 502s?
mike: ```
2026-03-15T22:06:11Z inference-api[pod-7f6d]: WARN 502 backend read timeout (model-serving) seq=120 prompt_len=2048
2026-03-15T22:06:12Z inference-api[pod-7f6d]: ERROR failed to stream tokens: upstream timeout
2026-03-15T22:06:13Z inference-api[pod-7f6d]: WARN 502 kernel exec timeout ms=1200
```

oncall-bot: incident-bot: Threshold breached: error_rate>2% for inference-api (eu-west). Paging rotation.

sarah: i'm oncall, taking this. what's the customer impact? any 1p/3p reporting? @mike any specifics?
jia: SLOs: error-burn for eu-west is ~150% of 5m budget. a few enterprise customers reported timeouts in chat UI (prod). No data loss reported.
sarah: ok. initial mitigation plan: stop canary traffic to v3.1.2 and route to stable. execute traffic-split rollback to v3.1.1 for eu-west.
alex: note: v3.1.2 introduced a new quantization kernel compile. might be related.
kevin: confirmed — v3.1.2 compiled with new int8 kernel (opt-path B). long prompt sequences (>=1k tokens) hit a regression in that kernel causing exec latency spikes.
sarah: performing rollback now. command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=12 -n eu-west`
deployment-bot: deployment-bot: rollback initiated for inference-api in eu-west. scaling pods to revision=12.
nataliE: observability — latency and 5xx rate are trending down after rollback start. 5xx at 1.1% right now (was 3.2).
sarah: also forcing routing: set routing.policy=stable-only for eu-west to avoid any accidental drift. enabling per-request 2x retry for 500s for a short window.
alex: good. can someone run the canary-analysis job against our 50 reference prompts and compare logits/outputs to ensure rollback didn't flip behavior?
mike-sre: running canary analysis now. will post diffs shortly.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2240013377 | Sev2 | Owner: mike-sre | start=2026-03-15T22:07Z
jia: customer impact summary for ops: 3 customers reported ~10-20 failed requests each during the 4m spike. CS has a draft message and will wait for final postmortem.
sarah: handing active validation to mike-sre for smoke tests and post-rollback checks. i'll stay for 15m then hand to on-call followup.
mike-sre: running smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> 200, stream active, tokens arriving. sample tests (50/50) passed local acceptance.
sarah: thanks. i'm closing the immediate pager (reduce noise) but leaving INC open for RCA and follow-up actions. root cause hypothesis: kernel selection regression + canary traffic skewed toward long sequences.
alex: followups: add long-seq traffic simulation to canary pipeline, add kernel sanity checks to compile step, and tighten canary error thresholds. filed DEV ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3257.
mike-sre: noted, moving to postmortem doc, will include timeline and requested mitigation tasks. :white_check_mark:
